info.name: RideLink - Fare & Payment Service (8084)
info.description: Fare estimation, final fare, simulated payments and receipts. Select an environment, then run the collection top to bottom.

item.name: 1. Estimate fare by place names (no token)

exec: pm.test("distance is about 95.8 km", function () { pm.expect(j.distanceKm).to.be.within(95, 97); });
pm.test("short trip is close to the minimum fare", function () { pm.expect(j.totalFare).to.be.above(250); pm.expect(j.totalFare).to.be.below(400); });

item.name: 6. Pay for the ride (PASSENGER, minimal body)

exec: pm.test("payment is COMPLETED with a receipt number", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("COMPLETED"); pm.expect(j.receiptNumber).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("amount comes from the stored fare", function () { pm.expect(j.amount).to.eql(582); });

item.name: 7. Get the payment and its status
8. List payment attempts for the ride

exec: pm.test("receipt shows the fare breakdown", function () { pm.expect(j.totalPaid).to.eql(582); pm.expect(j.receiptNumber).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.distanceKm).to.eql(5.4); });
pm.test("Error body has status 400 and a message", function () { var e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql(400); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: 8. Final fare with no distance and no locations (400)

exec: pm.test("Error body has status 400 and a message", function () { var e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql(400); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Error body has status 404 and a message", function () { var e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: 10. Payment for a ride with no fare (404)

exec: pm.test("Error body has status 404 and a message", function () { var e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Error body has status 400 and a message", function () { var e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql(400); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: 12. Setup: final fare for a second ride (DRIVER)

exec: pm.test("status is FAILED with a reason and no receipt", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("FAILED"); pm.expect(j.failureReason).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.receiptNumber === null || j.receiptNumber === undefined).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Error body has status 409 and a message", function () { var e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql(409); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("two attempts, COMPLETED first", function () { pm.expect(j.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j[0].status).to.eql("COMPLETED"); pm.expect(j[1].status).to.eql("FAILED"); });
